result:
The merge is done: `mk-wt/index.html` is now 4.23.0 and all F1 fixes are still in it. Two things are still open: on P2/P3 and in landscape the Micro chip and genre tabs don't reach 44 × 44 px, and Echo Voc peaks at +0.1 dBTP with the synthetic formant WAV.

**Merge:** I backed up the main line to `mk-wt/index.html.vor-merge-G-MK8b-merge.html`, then ran `git merge-file` against `mk-base-E.html` with MK8b. There was one conflict, `VERSION` (main 4.22.0, MK8b 4.23.0), resolved to 4.23.0. No conflict markers remain, the smoke test shows no errors, and the file is 3,370,195 B (+40,849 B over 4.22.0, under the 46,080 B budget).

**Extra items from the task, all done in the merged app:**
1. **Kompakt → Micro:** renamed everywhere: chip, aria-label, help line, comments and the data block (`SQ_MK_MICRO`). The build script `v3-mk8b-bau.mjs` now writes the new name (backup kept as `.vor-G-MK8b-merge`). There is no Korg/microKORG/RADIAS/DWGS word in the file, and "MS 2000" appears exactly once.
2. **Stored waves:** "Platzhalter" and "die Originalwellen folgen später" are gone; the 64 waves are labelled "nachgezeichnet" and ≈ appears only on wave 60. `v3-mk2-wellen` is all PASS.
3. **Reverted:** the mic no longer restarts on its own when the page comes back from the background; it stays off and the existing hint shows. ▶ Hören in the ⋯ menu plays immediately again, and the menu still scrolls by finger.
4. **Touch targets (marker editor raster and landscape header buttons):** now 44–46 px hit areas. They are invisible except where 8 × 44 px can't fit in one row: on portrait under 390 px (P2) the 8 raster buttons now sit in 2 rows of 4, like P3. In P2 that shrinks the waveform from 114 to 70 px; in P3 from 69 to 63 px (still above the 60 px minimum).
5. **The four MK8b findings plus (d)–(f):**
   - (a) The genre tabs carry exactly the spec names in every format.
   - (b) The `.mkkvoc` hint row is removed; only the Claude-window hint from 4.17.0 remains.
   - (c) At 320 × 568, row sub-labels wrap instead of showing "…": 0 of 128 cut, was 87.
   - (d) I recalibrated the 16 vocoders against a natural vowel and the formant WAV. Only the vocoder entries in `v3-mk8b-cal.json` changed (backup kept); the other 112 programs are bit-identical. All 16 now sit at −20.9…−16.1 LUFS with the vowel and −19.9…−15.4 with the WAV. Metal Voc moved from −27.5/−31.3 to −16.1/−19.9.
   - (e) Micro chip and genre tabs have a 46.9 px hit height on P1 and W, with no visible change.
   - (f) Loading a vocoder program now takes 1.8–5.6 ms with no long task (was 74 ms). The mic starts right after the load, and if no audio has played yet in the session, the audio engine starts once mic permission is granted rather than before the request.

Tests whose expectations are now intentionally outdated are listed in the changelog. `v3-mk2-ui` expects ≈ on all 64 waves; I did not run it.

**Still open:**
- **Chip hit areas on P2/P3 and landscape:** I didn't build these because they can't be done invisibly. The portrait chip row is 41 px tall, and in landscape the tabs sit 37 px apart. Fixing it would need a 4 px taller row or 12 px gaps, both visible, so it's under "Fragen an Xander".
- **Echo Voc peak:** +0.1 dBTP with the formant WAV; its loudness is fine, but lowering the peak would push the vowel reading below −21 LUFS.
- **Slow vocoder decay:** after a double stop, Voc Strings and Pad Voc still sound for about 2 s. The branch already did this; it is not caused by the merge and not part of this task.
- **Server:** `max_app` must be raised to ≥ 4023000 before shipping. The SQL is in the changelog; I did not run it.

The merge agent's own script gives the same result: node .../dirigent-test/gmk8b-hit44.mjs .../mk-wt/index.html → FAIL 5 (P2 P3 L1 L2 XL). By hand: track 1 → engine MS 2000 → open the library → chip row.

findings.actual: Micro chip and genre tabs: P2/P3 hit height 40.9 px, L1/L2/926×428 37.0–37.9 px. They pass only in P1 and W (46.9 px). All other library chips: 36.9 px high in P1 and 375×812, and 32.9 px in P2/P3/L1/L2/X (e.g. 'Init' 40.6×36.9 in P1; 'Nur MS 2000-Sounds' 73×32.9 in P2). Header: A/B 37.6×40.9 in P1 (33.6×34.5 in L2), back button 53×40.9, ✕ 44.9×40.9 (40.9×34.5 in landscape). Footer Sichern/Importieren/Exportieren 40.9 px (P1) / 36.9 px (P2/P3) / 34.9 px (landscape). The changelog defers the Micro/genre part to 'Fragen an Xander'. The other library chips were not addressed at all.

findings.title: Echo Voc true peak rose to +0.1 dBTP after the merge's vocoder recalibration (spec MK8b Umfang 2 / MK8b-03: peak limit as MK8-04, ≤ −1 dBTP)
findings.repro: cd /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Deutsch-Mit-Xander/9f6e2ea9-5438-5564-bb39-64bc754f0143/scratchpad/dirigent-test && node gmk8b-vocal.mjs ../mk-wt/index.html v3-qa-mk8b/vowel.wav (offline mkRender, held chords, E2 = formant-vowel WAV at −20 dBFS RMS). For comparison run the same command on ../mk-br-MK8b/index.html.
findings.expected: All 16 vocoder programs are within −18 ± 3 LUFS and have a true peak of at most −1 dBTP, like every MK8 program (MK8-04), with a natural voice input.
findings.actual: 'FAIL Echo Voc  -20.5  -15.4  -18.0  0.1 [-6.8 / 0.1]': the true peak with the formant WAV is +0.1 dBTP, i.e. over full scale. In the MK8b branch the same measurement gives −1.4 dBTP, so the merge's +dB recalibration (5d) introduced it. LUFS of all 16 is within range (vowel −20.9…−16.1, WAV −19.9…−15.4). The changelog lists this as open rather than fixing it.
